referee.justification: Booked law genuinely underdetermines the question, and the underdetermination is demonstrated from booked text, not presumed from deference. The verdict obtains because BOTH non-force demonstrations succeed. (1) WIRE-AND-CAP is not forced. Its entire force chain runs through a bridge premise — tier semantics are format-blind; a priced input caps regardless of booking format — that appears nowhere in booked law: grep at HEAD e76953a confirms 'format may not change epistemic consequence' occurs only in the P1B protocol's own outcome gloss (line 31). CHARTER §1 defines only derived-pending; 'shown' has no booked satisfaction conditions anywhere (booked as P1A verifier correction 4), so the cap requires the converse reading of an undefined predicate. Worse for force: CHARTER §2's own settled state enacts the disputed configuration — 'shown — the four legs: in-in/CTP ... verified vs primaries' stands in the same settled list as 'assumed (name each at the rung it enters) — the system/bath split (the deepest)' — the constitution's own usage glosses shown as verification-grade at exactly the node in question while naming its deepest input in prose at the rung. The resident's rule-(2) sentence is edge-scoped by its own code (it iterates depends_on; the check's docstring disclaims truth-checking; flags never block), and P1A ratified precisely the edge semantics while triple-fencing the prose extension ('recorded, not adopted'; 'not decided here'; 'both answers stay available'). R5's trigger clause is 'When an omission is banked'; the four inputs are declared, priced, enumerated, and owner-verified in the node's own text — the opposite of conjunct 1's invisibility tell — and the standard's STANDING LIMIT makes conjunct application C3-class analyst judgment while R1 refuses exactly the settle-by-tidier-convention move. Register practice is not even uniform: rung6 prices two inputs and wires only one (born_rule has a node and edge; the quantization/single-valuedness condition has neither — verified at HEAD, no such node exists), so the alleged priced-and-wired convention does not exist as practice either. Finally, WIRE-AND-CAP's own enactment concedes it would empty the 2026-08-09-legislated waiver's shown/derived domain (its guard spec: laundering_ok no longer waives at shown/derived) and must silently choose between two booked result-tier vocabularies (resident RESULT_TIERS = {shown, derived} vs auditor LAUNDERABLE_TIERS including derived-pending — under the latter, rung1 is a live subject TODAY, contradicting the protocol's zero-present-changes finding). Narrowing a legislated instrument's domain and choosing between two booked vocabularies are acts of legislation, not reading. The advocate's own filing concedes the fallback: 'If the referee holds that force-by-absence is not force, the correct fallback on this record is LEGISLATION-REQUIRED.' I so hold: in this program, force means a positive booked sentence, and there is none. (2) PROSE-SUFFICIENT is not forced either. Its 'intended law' must live somewhere, and every candidate fails on booked text: the stance_justification is certified by auditor 1b to EXIST, expressly 'not verified for TRUTH', and the stanza books the convention as 'NEVER BEEN SCREENED' — in a program whose CHARTER §1.3 requires adversarial pre-screening BEFORE banking, an unscreened builder-authored sentence cannot be forced law (the self-certification shape the program polices); the waiver machinery establishes gate-LEGALITY under an engine whose docstring caps its authority at discipline, and the P1A correction's own booked sentence scopes the waiver to 'the +delta LAUNDERING block' — tier-orthogonal; the 2026-08-17 owner booking is behavioral acquiescence, the evidence class the P1A referee discounted by name, on a record where P1B was opened as reserved the very next day; §2's coexistence evidences permission at enactment, but it is a starting state since moved by P1A's demotion, and the P1A closure's own present-tense description of the asymmetry ends 'pending P1B' with the cross-ref adding 'both answers stay available'. Permission-to-date plus an open stanza asking whether the permission is right is not a booked answer that it is right — and the pre-registered PROSE-SUFFICIENT-FORCED outcome requires recording the asymmetry as INTENDED law, which would manufacture the very ruling the stanza says was never given (the advocate's own fallback paragraph concedes 'permitted' is what the books actually support). One law-shaped gap and one unscreened declaration are not two laws; but neither are they one law — they are a register that has operated TWO tier semantics (verification-grade at rung1 for months on the gate's printed face; input-carrying imposed by P1A for wired inputs only) with no booked sentence choosing between them. That is underdetermination shown, not deference taken. I do not rest the verdict on the stanza's 'CLOSES WHEN: the owner rules' clause or on prospectivity alone — the protocol pre-registered FORCED outcomes as reachable for prospective doctrine, so those would be circular grounds. The verdict rests entirely on the two demonstrations above.
referee.strongest_surviving_counter: The cap half of WIRE-AND-CAP nearly forces on the FOURTH input specifically. CHARTER §4's Premature-graduation clause — 'Awaiting a computation ⇒ derived-pending, not derived' — is booked law, format-blind in its own text (it mentions computations, never edges), and rung1's fourth input (the 4d-covariant Ward gauge-orbit zero) carries an explicit 'DISCHARGE CONDITION' awaiting a named computation (the KC5-reserved 4d/Bardeen completion), per rung1's own ledger_note. On a future re-promotion of rung1 to shown with that input still open, §4's demotion condition sits in direct tension with the tier — arguably no P1B legislation needed for that one instance. The answer that keeps this from overturning the verdict, honestly stated: §4 addresses the node's OWN settling check ('derived requires a settling check'), and whether it reaches a node's entry-price inputs — as opposed to the node's own pending computation — is exactly the never-screened scope question; it reaches at most one input of four (the other three are permanent constitutive posits with no discharge route, the shape P1A itself flagged as fitting derived-pending 'imperfectly', booking tier-ladder granularity as prospective owner legislation); and even granting the cap on that input, the WIRE half (which vocabulary, which nodes, fence tests, delta placement, waiver domain) remains a family of unforced choices — so the pre-registered bundled outcome WIRE-AND-CAP-FORCED is still unreachable. But the §4 tension is real, textual, and survives this ruling; the owner package must present it explicitly rather than bury it.
referee.where_the_freedom_lies_if_legislation: Precisely: booked law nowhere defines what a result tier ('shown'/'derived') asserts about a node's DECLARED entry-price inputs. §1 defines only derived-pending; 'shown' has no booked satisfaction conditions; and the register has operated two incompatible semantics with constitutional footprints on both sides — (A) the input-carrying reading (a result tier cannot stand on an open input, whatever its booking format), which P1A enacted for WIRED inputs only, and (B) the verification-grade reading (the tier grades verification against primaries; the ledger triad — ledger_delta + laundering_ok + gate-mandatory stance_justification — carries declared inputs), which CHARTER §2's own settled list glossed ('verified vs primaries') and which the gate's WAIVED-BY-STANCE face-print was designed around. Choosing between them — equivalently, ruling whether P1A's format asymmetry is intended law or an enforcement gap — writes the missing sentence rather than reads an existing one, and is therefore the owner's. Subsidiary freedoms that only exist under choice (A): which booked 'result tier' vocabulary the rule quantifies over (resident RESULT_TIERS = {shown, derived} vs auditor LAUNDERABLE_TIERS = {shown, derived, derived-pending} — under the latter rung1 is in scope TODAY); per-input R1 membership-fence tests (C3-class, analyst-proposed); the tier of any newly booked input nodes; delta placement (the +4 stays home vs relocates — the 2026-08-04 n-sided double-count arithmetic must not be silently re-broken); guard semantics (BLOCK vs FLAG-FOR-FIREWALL — resident.py's own comment says heuristics do not hard-block); and whether the waiver instrument's shown/derived domain is deliberately retired (a repeal the owner must own, not inherit). Subsidiary freedom under choice (B): whether the asymmetry gets a disclosure surface (e.g. the gate's waiver block naming prose-priced inputs as ruled-sufficient) so it sits on the face as law rather than habit.
referee.recommendation_if_legislation: Recommend to the owner, marked as recommendation and not law: adopt the PRINCIPLE of option (A) — a result tier is an input-carrying predicate; named open inputs of result-tier nodes must be machine-visible as depends_on edges to booked nodes, whereupon the ruled tier rule caps at derived-pending — with conservative mechanics: quantify over resident RESULT_TIERS (shown/derived) so enactment is genuinely prospective (state the LAUNDERABLE_TIERS alternative and its present-day consequence for rung1 explicitly so the choice is the owner's); new input nodes booked at zero delta with the price staying home on the host (preserving the 2026-08-04 n-sided arithmetic and the auditor's blind-sum semantics); per-input fence tests run per R1/R3 before booking (the Ward zero and Gaussian truncation plausibly pass; a generic-calibration-shaped input is a rider, not a node); the guard as FLAG-FOR-FIREWALL, not BLOCK, per resident.py's heuristics-don't-hard-block comment; shipped as a dated successor standard (supersede, never edit, per the prereg discipline). Grounds: the program's deepest repeated lesson is that load-bearing prose invisible to instruments goes blind (R5's pinned rationale, the S1 blindness, §7's real hole, and this stanza's own 'A GREEN SUITE WOULD THEN BE THE ANSWER'), and the strongest booked rationale in this territory points at computability of dependency signals. Couple it — in the same package, because P1A booked it as this rule's known ceiling — with the tier-granularity question: whether permanent constitutive posits need a landing tier distinct from derived-pending ('pending' strains on inputs with no discharge route), and present the §4 fourth-input tension named in the surviving counter. State option (B)'s coherence honestly: it fits R1's refusal of tidiness conventions, avoids node-inflation past the membership fence, and matches §2's own enacted usage; if the owner chooses it, require the disclosure tightening (the gate's waiver block printing prose-priced inputs as ruled-sufficient with the ruling's date) so the asymmetry stands on the face as law. Either choice is coherent; the choice is the owner's because it is new law.
